item.title: Kalshi Co-Founder Reveals How Superfans Earn Six Figures From Music Prediction Markets
item.description:
[Intro music plays]
Host: Welcome to this week's episode of "Trending on Billboard". Today, we're exploring how music prediction markets are changing the game for fans and the music industry. Joining me is Luana Lopes Lara, COO and co-founder of Kalshi, a platform where fans can bet on future events, including music-related outcomes.
[Short music transition]
Host: Luana, thanks for being here. Your platform has seen a significant surge in music-related trades, with over $400 million traded so far in 2026. What's driving this growth?
Luana Lopes Lara: We're seeing a lot of interest from music fans who are passionate about artists and want to turn their expertise into real money. They're trading on charts, streaming numbers, and other music-related events. It's a way for superfans to monetize their dedication and hobby.
Host: That's fascinating. We've heard stories of fans earning significant amounts, like Brandon Fean, an Ariana Grande superfan who dug himself out of student loan debt, and an IT professional who made over $380,000 just on music markets. Can you tell us more about these success stories?
Luana Lopes Lara: Yes, these fans are extremely passionate about music and have a deep understanding of the industry. They're using Kalshi to turn their knowledge into cash. It's not just about the money, though - our platform also provides a social aspect where fans can engage with each other and share their expertise.
Host: That raises an interesting question: how do you think monetizing fandom will impact the fan experience?
Luana Lopes Lara: Honestly, I think it can enhance the fan experience. By providing a way for fans to earn money from their passion, we're giving them a new way to engage with the music they love. It can also create new opportunities for partnerships between fans, artists, and other platforms.
[Outro music plays]
Host: Thanks, Luana, for shedding light on this exciting trend. If you want to learn more about Kalshi and music prediction markets, check out the full episode on our podcast platforms. Until next time, thanks for tuning in to "Trending on Billboard"!
